coverage: 248 reviewed Linux bindings from the 21.1 manual: project/media, Edit playback/tracks, multicam angles 1-9, Photo, and selected Fusion/Color/Fairlight commands. Core subset; excludes user/NLE presets, ambiguous Delete keys, held gestures, hardware panels and undocumented ranges. Version, active preset and focused panel are unverified. See row page locators and davinci-resolve.md.
translation: Manual pp. 54 and 68 specify Command -> CTRL and Option -> ALT on Linux. Chords use XKB key names (slash, backslash, bracketleft, bracketright, equal, minus, grave), lowercase letter keysyms and explicit SHIFT. No physical-key or keyboard-layout mapping is inferred.

references.text: Resolve 21.1 can inherit updated non-conflicting defaults into a custom preset. Inspect the active preset after updates; documentation defaults do not resolve overrides.

Dedicated multicam shortcuts can be assigned through angle 25. Only angles 1-9 have default cut/switch chords documented here. Inspect Keyboard Customization for the rest; do not extrapolate number bindings.
Held K with J/L, tapping while holding K, and continuous dynamic-trim gestures are outside this chord catalog and cannot be encoded as ordinary WCU modifier chords.
